title: Umphefumulo Ohlushwayo waseNayile
intro: Enkathini yokucindezelwa okukhulu, lapho umashiqela ebusa izwe ngonya olukhulu, umphefumulo owodwa wakhetha indlela yokholo kunenduduzo yobukhosi. Lo muntu wayehlala enhliziyweni yamandla kodwa wathola iqiniso esigijimini somprofethi othobekile. Uhambo lwabo lwaluyoba isifundo esingapheli sokubekezela, ukuzidela, kanye nokuqiniseka okungantengantengi. Ungamthola lo muntu ophawulekayo owayethanda injabulo yaphezulu kunesikhundla sezwe?
clues: Bengihlala esigodlweni esinamandla amakhulu, kodwa inhliziyo yami yathola iqiniso esigijimini esithobekile.
Ngakhetha ukulandela isiqondiso sikaMusa, ngazi imiphumela engizobhekana nayo.
Ngangishade nombusi onamandla kunabo bonke ngesikhathi sami, kodwa ngabenqaba onkulunkulu bakhe bamanga.
Ukuhlupheka kwami ​​kwakunzima kakhulu, njengoba ngangijeziswa ngokukholelwa kwami ​​kuNkulunkulu oyedwa.
Angikaze ngintengantenge okholweni lwami, ngisho nalapho ngibhekene nokuhlupheka okunzima kakhulu.
INkosi yami yajabula ngesineke sami yangikhethela indawo ehloniphekile ePharadesi.
arabic: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ٱبْنِ لِى عِندَكَ بَيْتًۭا فِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِى مِن فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And Allāh presents an example of those who believed: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, "My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people." (66:11)
